AttemptIn.description: An answer: exactly one of ``option`` (index into the stored options) or ``custom_to``.
AttemptIn.title: AttemptIn

AttemptResult.description: A stored attempt's full result: the stored grade plus the frozen puzzle's reveal.
AttemptResult.title: AttemptResult

Explanation.description:
Plain-English explanation of a result. Every number in it was computed by the grader and
formatted by code; a language model may only reword it (``source == "llm"``).
Explanation.title: Explanation

NewPuzzleIn.description:
Both optional: a null street is random; a null profile uses the settings, then random;
``"random"`` is random whatever the settings say.
NewPuzzleIn.title: NewPuzzleIn

PuzzleView.description: Everything visible at the table before an answer; nothing Villain-side or undealt.
PuzzleView.title: PuzzleView

SettingsPatch.description: Partial update: only fields the client sent are applied (``profile: null`` = random).
SettingsPatch.title: SettingsPatch

StatsHeadline.description:
Means over the last 50 first attempts; ``ev_lost_bb_prev50`` is attempts 51-100 back,
null until there are 100. All null with no attempts.
StatsHeadline.title: StatsHeadline

TrendPoint.description: One first attempt with rolling means over the last 50 first attempts ending at it.
TrendPoint.title: TrendPoint

get.description:
The explanation to show: the local model's rewording when the provider is on and its
output passes the guardrail, else the template with the reason. Never a 5xx because of the
model. The database session is closed before the model is asked (that can take a minute).
